build_lm_model: build a LMModel instance with a pattern provider, condition provider, and fuser for audio codebook modeling
generate_audio_tokens: generate audio tokens from a prompt using LMModel.generate with top-k sampling and classifier-free guidance
compute_predictions: compute predictions and logits for input codes using LMModel.compute_predictions with a code interleaving pattern
sample_next_token: sample the next token from the model using _sample_next_token with greedy or top-p sampling strategies
init_lm_weights: initialize LMModel transformer weights using gaussian or uniform initialization with optional depthwise scaling
